title: Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Terms of Agreement: Signing and Withdrawal
content:
## Terms of agreement — signing and withdrawing a Payoff and Loan Satisfaction agreement

**Taking funds before signature.** **No longer in force.** The clause under which, on plans that need a signed agreement, nothing is taken toward satisfaction until the borrower or confirmed successor signs the agreement under the issued terms is no longer in force as worded here; it has been superseded by the current basis for funds taken before signature.

**Who signs.** Only the borrower or the confirmed successor can sign or withdraw, and the servicer records that person's own signed submission.

**Signature window.** An agreement is accepted only when it is signed no later than the plan's signature period of calendar days after the terms were issued. The clock starts from the statement date recorded on the payoff case. Those days are counted as calendar days starting the day after the statement date, and a signature on the last counted day still qualifies; a later signature is declined for the reason that the signature window has passed, and new terms must be issued.

**Proof of funds.** A Heir Retention Payoff agreement is issued for signature only after proof of funds or a financing commitment is on file, as the plan's proof-of-funds setting provides.

**Deed in lieu.** A Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure is accepted only when the property is vacant and title carries no other lien, as the plan's vacancy and clear-title settings provide; otherwise it is declined for the reason that the property is not vacant or that title is not clear.

**Withdrawal.** A requester may withdraw before satisfaction, including after signing where the plan allows withdrawal after acceptance; held funds are then returned to their remitters.

### Boundary of the signature window

On a plan whose signature period is 15 calendar days (the period shown in the plan schedule for the agreement plans):

| Day the signature is dated | Result |
|---|---|
| The statement date itself | inside the window |
| The 15th calendar day after the statement date | inside the window (last counted day) |
| The 16th calendar day after the statement date | declined; new terms must be issued |

The days are counted on the calendar, weekends and holidays included, and the statement date itself is not one of the counted days.

superseded_clauses: On plans whose acceptance_required is true, nothing is taken toward satisfaction until the borrower or confirmed successor signs the agreement under the issued terms;
